column1: # Pixel CYD 4 MB Launcher-compatible partition table
# Compatible with bmorcelli/Launcher dynamic partitioner (isFactoryOrTestApp + otadata).
# Uses 'factory' subtype so stock Arduino ESP32 bootloader (espressif32 @ 6.10.0) boots it
# directly when otadata is empty/erased; Launcher's partitioner protects both factory and test.
# dynamically allocated OTA app slots and their SPIFFS/FAT/LittleFS data partitions.
